report_name: Law Firm Investigates Class Action Following Medical Data Rx Breach

threat_actors.name: The Gentlemen/VYPR
threat_actors.description: A ransomware group that conducted a financially motivated attack against Medical Data Rx. The attack involved data encryption and likely data exfiltration for extortion purposes.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor encrypted files on Medical Data Rx's systems as part of a ransomware attack, rendering data and systems inaccessible.

attack_patterns.name: Proxy
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor likely used Tor for command and control or data exfiltration, as implied by the pre-extracted observable pattern for detecting connections to Tor exit nodes.

identities.name: Medical Data Rx
identities.description: A Michigan-based healthcare IT service provider targeted in a ransomware attack by The Gentlemen/VYPR, resulting in a data breach and operational disruption.

indicators.name: Ransomware Note File Creation
indicators.pattern:
title: Ransomware Note File Creation
id: 7c5b9f8a-1d2e-4f3c-8a9b-0123456789ab
status: experimental
description: Detects the creation of a file named RANSOM_NOTE.txt, which is a common indicator of a ransomware infection.
references:
  - https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/10/16/3382778/0/en/medical-data-rx-data-breach-investigation-edelson-lechtzin-llp-probes-class-action-claims-after-customer-data-is-exposed.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-17
tags:
  - attack.t1486
  - attack.impact
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|endswith: '\RANSOM_NOTE.txt'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the creation of a file named RANSOM_NOTE.txt, a common indicator of ransomware activity, based on pre-extracted cyber observables.

indicators.name: Outbound Connection to Tor Exit Node
indicators.pattern:
title: Outbound Connection to Tor Exit Node
id: 8d4c1a9b-2e3f-4d5c-9b0a-fedcba987654
status: experimental
description: Detects outbound network connections to IP addresses associated with Tor exit nodes. This rule requires a threat intelligence feed of known Tor exit nodes to populate the selection.
references:
  - https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2026/10/16/3382778/0/en/medical-data-rx-data-breach-investigation-edelson-lechtzin-llp-probes-class-action-claims-after-customer-data-is-exposed.html
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-17
tags:
  - attack.t1090
  - attack.command_and_control
level: medium
logsource:
  category: network_connection
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    # This list should be populated by a threat intelligence feed of known Tor exit nodes.
    DestinationIp:
      - '1.2.3.4' # Placeholder, replace with actual TI feed
    Initiated: true
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects outbound network connections to Tor exit nodes, suggesting the use of anonymization networks for C2 or exfiltration. This is based on a pre-extracted network traffic pattern.
